builds.hypothesis: R6 deals100+0.35AP per second for4s; awaken adds level-scaled8%-14%+0.035% perAP target maxHP over duration. AP/MR modifiers increase both. Deathcap multiplies AP; Zhonya adds105AP; Riftmaker adds bonusHP-to-AP and8% full-ramp damage. Void/Shadowflame penetrate MR and amplify eligible low-health hits. Nearby Abyssal makes target take12% more magic damage. 30min Gathering Storm adaptive stats fixed; Absolute Focus requires ownerabove70%HP. First Strike ready but separate proc reported outside target packet; compare inactive.

kitEvidence.formula:
Storm Stance: Udyr surrounds himself in a glacial storm for [4] seconds, dealing [20 / 36 / 52 / 68 / 84 / 100 + (0.35) × AP] magic damage per second to nearby enemies and Slowing them by [(0.15 / 0.18 / 0.21 / 0.24 / 0.27 / 0.3) × 100]%. Additionally, Udyr's next two Attacks in this stance deal [characterLevelInterpolation(10 → 40; raw flags preserved) + (0.35) × AP] magic damage to enemies in the storm.

Awaken: Unleash the storm, causing it to follow Udyr's last Attacked enemy, deal an additional [characterLevelInterpolation(0.08 → 0.14; raw flags preserved) + (0.00035) × AP] max Health magic damage over the duration, and Slow by an additional [0.05].
